1789. Online Payment Processing System

40

Medium

Online Payment Processing System
Problem Statement

Design an Online Payment Processing System using Object-Oriented Programming concepts in C++.

The system must demonstrate:

Abstract Class

Inheritance

Method Overriding

Runtime Polymorphism (using base class pointer)

User Input Driven Execution

System Description

An e-commerce platform supports different payment methods:

Credit Card

UPI

Net Banking

Each payment method calculates transaction charges differently.

Requirements
Create an Abstract Base Class: Payment
Private Members:

double amount

Public Methods:

Constructor to initialize amount

double getAmount()

Pure Virtual Function:

virtual double calculateFinalAmount() = 0;

Virtual Destructor

Derived Classes
CreditCard

Charge: 2% processing fee

Final Amount = amount + (2% of amount)

UPI

Charge: 0.5% processing fee

Final Amount = amount + (0.5% of amount)

NetBanking

Flat fee of ₹10

Final Amount = amount + 10

Input Format

First Line → Number of transactions (N)

For each transaction:

paymentType amount

Where:

paymentType:

1 → CreditCard

2 → UPI

3 → NetBanking

Output Format

For each transaction print:

Final Amount: <value upto 2 decimal places>

After all transactions print:

Total Processed Amount: <sum upto 2 decimal places>
